title: verify() reports divergence after a logged detach-delete involving named-graph edges
intended: RPL-B7: verify says equal when every change went through the ledger.
observed: Fresh rerun: verify on the built world already diverges, only on tenantA|n3 (the detach delete kept its named-graph row).
remedy: Make the ledger's detach-delete and verify agree on node identity across graphs (HD-1401/HD-1101).

title: A reader can return a partially redacted view
intended: RPL-I1 / HD-1401: a reader returns a consistent pre- or post-redaction view or the documented in-progress result.
observed: Fresh rerun: the reader's view shows tenant A's graph half redacted. Intent lane B: a whole redaction can finish between two pages of one reconstruct() call with the marker absent before and after, so the post-read marker re-check proposed in the original review cannot detect it (an epoch check would).
remedy: Validate a reader's whole read against a redaction epoch (counter bumped by every batch and Final) and retry or refuse on change.
notes: The original reviewed reader design (marker re-check) is insufficient for multi-page reads.
